guidance.edgar: General Dynamics gives its annual outlook on the earnings conference call (Jan / Apr / Jul / Oct), not in the 8-K release or any other EDGAR filing. The Q3-26 release (30-Oct-2026) and 10-Q carry no numeric guidance.
guidance.policy: No guidance is verifiable from EDGAR, so the FY26 outlook cells in the scenario table are optional inputs (blank by default). With a blank target the Q4/26E calibration Δ is 0 and Q4/26E is driven by the prior-year quarter × (1 + 9M-26 y/y growth) with the prior-year margin + 9M drift. Enter the latest call guidance (marked UNVERIFIED — outside EDGAR) in the scenario table to activate the calibration.

segments.history: 2006 - Q1-2018: Aerospace, Combat Systems, Marine Systems, Information Systems and Technology (IS&T). Q2-2018 (after the CSRA acquisition, 3-Apr-2018): IS&T split into Information Technology and Mission Systems (2017 comparatives recast). From Q4-2020 (release of 27-Jan-2021): Information Technology and Mission Systems recombined as Technologies (2019 comparatives recast). The model carries one continuous Technologies line (= IS&T to Q1-18, IT + Mission Systems Q2-18 to 2019) with IT / Mission Systems / IS&T as memo rows.
segments.deals: CSRA Inc. acquired 3-Apr-2018 for ~$9.7bn including assumed debt (8-K 3-Apr-2018, Items 2.01 / 2.03); Jet Aviation Nov-2008; Axletech sold 2011 (discontinued operations); axle business (Combat Systems) sold 2014 (discontinued operations, prior periods restated in the 2014 releases); no acquisitions of size since 2018.

fcf_exceptions.Q2-16: The Q2-2016 release prints second-quarter free cash flow of $324m, which does not reconcile with its own year-to-date figures (six-month FCF $739m - first-quarter $374m = $365m = Q2 CFO $434m - capex $69m). The model shows the year-to-date-derived figure and excludes this quarter from the published-FCF check (known, explained source difference).

sumq_exceptions.2014: Axle business moved to discontinued operations in Q3-2014 (sold Jun-2014): Q1-14 and Q2-14 as originally reported include axle revenue ($59m) in Combat Systems; FY2014 (Q4 release / 10-K) excludes it, so the quarters do not sum to the year (revenue +59, costs +62, operating earnings -3).
sumq_exceptions.2016: Discontinued operations: FY2016 $(107)m vs the sum of the quarters as reported $(94)m; the Q4-2016 release restated earlier quarters for the final axle-sale loss adjustment (not recast in the model).
sumq_exceptions.2020: Q4-2020 release: retrospective change in accounting principle (prior-period information restated); Q1-Q3 2020 as originally reported differ from the FY2020 figures by $26m in operating costs / other, net (corporate operating earnings -30 vs -56).
